proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord.attunementRestriction = { kind: "spellcaster" }
proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item record can express that attunement is required, but not who is eligible to attune. This wand's cast/recharge/destruction mechanics fit today; only the attunement qualifier is missing.

notes: Authored successfully as an activation-family magic item. The fixed save DC is representable via grant_spell_access.dcOverride with DcSource.fixed. Outcome remains surface_widening because the spellcaster-only attunement restriction is not representable.
